units.source_text: 中将去后，源氏公子看见霜凋的草中有龙胆花与抚子花正在盛开，

en.t: After the lieutenant had gone, Prince Genji saw gentians and pinks blooming in their full beauty among the grasses withered by frost,

units.source_text: 便命侍女折取抚子花一枝，写一封信，

en.t: so he ordered a maid to pluck one spray of pinks and wrote a letter,

units.source_text: 叫小公子的乳母宰相君将花和信呈送老夫人。

en.t: then had Saisho no Kimi, the young prince's nurse, present the flower and the letter to the old lady.
